provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: E_a/E_f are initialized from dangle/dfre*0.0 (L28-L29) making them one shorter than the axes; D_f/D_a grow implicitly; 'angle' shadows the MATLAB builtin; contour-level vector v @L71 and the commented totalE @L82 are unused
audit_member_text: v is defined at L71, but both consumers that use v are commented out at L72 and L74 while contourf at L73 uses the literal level count 40, leaving v disconnected from the active contour path (L71-L74).

base_member_text: Energy normalizations differ: Etotal @L9 divides the squared-Hmo sum by 8 while the componentwise E @L12 also uses /8 — for Hmo per component the usual energy is Hmo^2/16; the script's Hrms values (L10, L83) depend on this convention which is not documented in-file

Dens is indexed (kf,ktheta) @L22 but Em is (ktheta,kf) @L20 — transposed storage; contourf(A,F,Dens,...) @L73 then pairs A (angle centers) with rows kf — consistent only because Dens rows are kf; the pcolor @L7 pairs fre as x with angle as y against spc whose orientation is (n=angles, m=freqs) per L16-L18 loops

audit_member_text: The raw pcolor drawn at L7 is later erased when figure(1) is selected and clf is called at L53-L54; no pause or save occurs between them, so the initial visualization has no lasting output (L7, L53-L54).

No nonzero or monotonic-spacing check precedes divisions by dangle and dfre at L22, L35, and L42; duplicate coordinate entries produce division by zero, and descending entries produce signed negative densities (L14-L15, L22, L35, L42).

If either loaded coordinate has fewer than two entries, the loops at L18-L26 and/or L31-L43 do not define Em, Dens, F, A, D_f, or D_a before those names are used at L46 and L56-L73; the file has no size guard (L16-L46, L56-L73).

The initial Etotal/Hrms path at L9-L10 is never consumed before Hrms is overwritten from Etotal_1 at L83 and only then displayed at L86; the first Hrms calculation is dead relative to observable output (L9-L10, L83, L86).
